text: My daily routine is simple, but I follow it every day. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and drink a glass of water. After a quick shower, I have breakfast and check my emails. I start work at nine and finish around five. In the afternoon, I take a short break and go for a walk. Later, I exercise for about thirty minutes, either running or doing yoga. In the evening, I cook dinner, watch a little TV, and read a book. I try to go to bed before eleven. Staying consistent helps me feel healthy and organized.
